title: Residential Tenancies Act
verified_how: the statutes register itself could NOT be reached (nslegislature.ca refused the connection - see access_notes), so in-force status is unverified and is recorded as unclear. The title and citation were verified instead on the Government of Nova Scotia's Office of the Registrar of Regulations site on 2026-09-23: fetched https://novascotia.ca/just/regulations/regs/rtgenrl.htm, which states it is made under subsection 12(4) and Section 26 of the Residential Tenancies Act and gives the enabling Act's citation as 'R.S.N.S. 1989, c. 401'; the Act also appears as a live heading in the official 'Regulations by Act' index at https://novascotia.ca/just/regulations/regsbyact.htm, which lists Acts with regulations currently in force
notes: Chosen for the tenancy half of the topic. The consumer half would be the Consumer Protection Act, R.S.N.S. 1989, c. 92, which was not separately verified; the schema allows one statute per topic.
